title: 第21章 六星冰凤武魂霜华刃第22章 镇压苏瑶揭开真相
content_zh:
第21章六星冰凤武魂，霜华刃！
苏瑶眼中露出一抹异色，随后，脸色很快变得平静。
林尘的剑道实力，确实很强，但，苏瑶照样有信心，可以压制他！
决赛第一场，苏瑶抽到的对手，乃是太初门的一位圣女。
展现六尾妖狐武魂的苏瑶，实力极强，仅仅一招就将其击败。
苏瑶的境界，如今更是达到了灵海境！
十四岁的灵海境，放在大禹皇朝都算得上天才。
得胜之后的苏瑶，更加意气风发。
林尘始终面色平静，心中没有波澜。
接下来，柳嫣然对战太初门圣子洪泽。
战台上，洪泽眼神邪恶，盯着柳嫣然的丰满娇躯看个不停。
“柳圣女，反正你也打不过我，倒不如握手言和，你直接跟我去太初门，做我道侣。”
洪泽大笑，满脸邪恶之色，整个青州当中，柳嫣然乃是第一美人。
她的容貌，放在大禹皇朝之中，恐怕也少有人能及。
闻言，柳嫣然眼中闪过一抹寒意。
人群中，柳嫣然看到了一位紫袍中年男子。
他的存在，让柳嫣然娇躯一颤，眼神变得坚定。
柳家，三长老到了！
柳嫣然是柳家嫡系，放养在青州城，如今青州武道大会，正是检验柳嫣然修炼成果的时候。
如果柳嫣然表现出色，三长老就会带她回柳家。

柳嫣然看向林尘，眸光澄澈，似是一泓秋水。
今日武道大会，柳嫣然必须得到三长老的认可。
如此，或许可以帮到林尘。
大禹学院公孙冶来者不善，柳嫣然担心，他会不顾脸面，强行对林尘出手！
“柳圣女，你可想好了？”
洪泽召唤出一只雷鸟武魂，浑身缭绕着紫色雷霆，气息狂暴。
柳嫣然眼神冷漠，召唤冰凤武魂，释放漫天冰花，强势杀来。
战台之上，雷电狂暴，冰雪满天。
虚空中，一朵朵冰莲绽放，整片演武场都充斥着一股肃杀寒意。
“这点实力，还奈何不得我。”
洪泽冷笑，拳法狂暴，携带着雷霆之威，势若千钧。
激战当中，柳嫣然的气息突然暴涨，武魂开始蜕变。
冰凤武魂冲天而起，绽放出漫天霜华！
武魂之威急速攀升，其品质，赫然达到了六星级！
人群中，柳家三长老脸色微变，眼中闪过一抹精光。
柳家当中，有不少天骄，柳嫣然虽然是主脉嫡系，但五星冰凤武魂，并不算惊艳。
柳家年轻一辈，觉醒五星武魂者，大有人在。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Six-star Ice Phoenix Martial Spirit, Frost Flower Blade!
Su Yao's eyes showed a strange color, and then her face quickly became calm.
Lin Chen's swordsmanship is indeed very strong, but Su Yao is still confident that she can suppress him!
In the first game of the final, Su Yao's opponent was a saint from the Taichu Sect.
Su Yao, who showed the spirit of the six-tailed demon fox, was extremely powerful and defeated it with just one move.
Su Yao's realm has now reached the Linghai realm!
At the age of fourteen, in the Linghai realm, he was considered a genius even in the Yu Dynasty.
After the victory, Su Yao became even more energetic.
Lin Chen always looked calm and had no worries in his heart.
Next, Liu Yanran fights against Hong Ze, the sage of the Taichu Sect.
On the battlefield, Hong Ze had evil eyes and couldn't stop staring at Liu Yanran's plump and delicate body.
"Sage Liu, you can't beat me anyway, so why not shake hands and make peace? You can go directly to Taichu Gate with me and become my Taoist companion."
Hong Ze laughed with an evil look on his face. Liu Yanran was the most beautiful woman in Qingzhou.
Her appearance was probably unparalleled by few people in the Yu Dynasty.
Hearing this, a chill flashed in Liu Yanran's eyes.
Among the crowd, Liu Yanran saw a middle-aged man in purple robe.
His presence made Liu Yanran's delicate body tremble and her eyes became firm.
Liu family, the third elder has arrived!
Liu Yanran is a direct descendant of the Liu family and is raised in Qingzhou City. Now the Qingzhou Martial Arts Conference is the time to test Liu Yanran's cultivation achievements.
If Liu Yanran performs well, the third elder will take her back to the Liu family.
Liu Yanran looked at Lin Chen, her eyes as clear as a stream of autumn water.
In today's martial arts conference, Liu Yanran must get the approval of the third elder.
In this way, it might be able to help Lin Chen.
Gongsun Ye of Dayu College came here with bad intentions, and Liu Yanran was worried that he would forcefully attack Lin Chen regardless of his face!
"Saint Liu, have you thought about it?"
Hong Ze summoned a thunderbird martial spirit, with purple thunder swirling all over its body and a violent aura.
Liu Yanran's eyes were cold, she summoned the ice phoenix martial spirit, released ice flowers all over the sky, and attacked with force.
On the battlefield, thunder and lightning raged, and the sky was filled with ice and snow.
In the void, ice lotuses blossomed, and the entire martial arts arena was filled with a chilling chill.
"With this little strength, there's nothing you can do about me."
Hong Ze sneered, his fists were violent, carrying the power of thunder, and he was as powerful as ever.
During the fierce battle, Liu Yanran's aura suddenly surged, and her martial soul began to transform.
The ice phoenix spirit soared into the sky, blooming with frost all over the sky!
The power of the martial spirit increased rapidly, and its quality suddenly reached six stars!
Among the crowd, the expression of the third elder of the Liu family changed slightly, and a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes.
There are many geniuses in the Liu family. Although Liu Yanran is a direct descendant of the main lineage, her five-star ice phoenix martial spirit is not amazing.
There are many young people in the Liu family who have awakened five-star martial spirits.
